title: Rethinking boundary detection in deep learning-based medical image segmentation (CTO)
mechanism: Boundary-guided decoder: fixed edge operators produce a binary boundary map that supervises a boundary-extraction module whose output is injected back into the decoder.
evidence: R (read): ISIC 2016 IoU 84.92 -> 86.60 vs Boundary loss 85.25 and Boundary DoU 85.70 on the same base; ISIC 2018 ablation BEM +0.5 IoU, BIM +0.4.
adaptation: Use only BEM/BIM on U-Net++ (no ViT stream). Sobel responses on EL fire on busbars, gridlines, cell edges and the 4 px crack ridge, independent of the jittered crack label.
min_experiment: Only if SBCB arm is positive: house + BEM/BIM vs house; gridline, edge_dark IoU, crack relF1@2; kill if mIoU_rob gain < 0.01 over the SBCB arm.
